excluded_coverage: Anthropic retired model IDs and provider-specific Bedrock/Vertex pricing are omitted.
Anthropic long-context and fast-mode variants are omitted because this pack has no verified adapter dimensions for those modes.

OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex credit rates are not USD/token rates; gpt-5.3-codex is included only for the explicitly published API pricing row and the exact api channel. Generic codex, codex-cli, ChatGPT-credit, and subscription-derived channels remain unpriced unless explicit API billing provenance is observed. Other Codex models and service tiers are omitted.

xAI long-context cards are omitted: the official page says long context starts at 200,000 tokens, but this snapshot has not verified a model-specific threshold and complete long-band dimensions for a safe card.
Cursor/Composer usage has no verified published USD/token rate for the contract's token meters and remains unpriced.
